name: R04 click, URL-loading init directives (one directive may span lines) and front-matter config are stripped before rendering

args.body:
Before the directives.

```mermaid
%%{init: {"themeCSS": "@import url(https://fonts.evil.example/f.css);"}}%%
flowchart LR
  A[Invoice] --> B[Reply]
  click A "https://evil.example/track" "Open"
  click B callbackFn
```

Front matter.

```mermaid
---
title: Invoice flow
config:
  theme: base
  themeCSS: "@import url(https://fonts.evil.example/f.css);"
  flowchart:
    htmlLabels: true
---
flowchart LR
  A --> B
```

Multi-line init.

```mermaid
%%{
  init: {"themeCSS": "@import url(https://evil.example/x.css);"}
}%%
flowchart LR
  C --> D
```
